release_name: Confirmatory Scientific Depth and Scale Upgrade
step155_upgrades: Adaptive interactive, extended and full native analysis budgets
Deterministic even-coverage bounded analysis instead of first-N sampling
Advanced GWAS association and genomic-inflation screening
Single-cell QC, highly-variable features, embedding, clustering and donor pseudobulk
Flow compensation, FMO thresholds and gate hierarchy evidence
Metabolomics blank correction, internal-standard normalisation and feature clustering
RDKit canonicalisation, descriptors and Murcko scaffold audit when available
Federated weighted aggregation, outlier screening and privacy-budget composition
Fourteen additional protected specialist execution plans
validation_boundary: Maximum internally verifiable repository implementation, deterministic packaging and bounded desktop scientific screening. It is not clinical, GxP, regulatory, licensed-database, physical-instrument, independent-laboratory or prospective wet-lab certification.
